g.title: TF_DW_INTENT_RESOURCES
g.text: Choose the parameter you would like to set, on disambiguation completed, with the disambiguated name field value.

g.title: TF_DW_INTENTS
g.text: A system prompt is normally a text with instructions or knowledge context that you might want to pass to the chatbot to properly answer to the request.
The user prompt is what you finally like asking the chatbot to generate, given the instructions above mentioned.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
